framings.text: I think this is about helping people read your blog more comfortably at night, including readers on hamster.
I think this is about offering a darker visual presentation of your blog for nighttime reading, with the intended reach to readers on hamster still unclear.

outcome: Readers can read the blog comfortably at night, including the intended readers on hamster.

questions.text: What is “hamster,” and where should readers experience this nighttime comfort?

alternatives.label: Manual dark appearance choice
alternatives.benefit: Readers who need relief can choose a darker presentation when reading at night. PROVISIONAL assumption: readers can access and retain this choice.
alternatives.cost: Readers must discover and use the choice.
alternatives.undo_cost: PROVISIONAL: removing it may leave some readers without a direct remedy.

alternatives.label: Automatic nighttime appearance
alternatives.benefit: The blog could adapt to a reader’s system or time-of-day preference without requiring a manual choice. PROVISIONAL assumption: the existing environment exposes a reliable preference.
alternatives.cost: Automatic changes may surprise readers or fail to match their actual needs.
alternatives.undo_cost: PROVISIONAL: reverting may require restoring the prior appearance behavior and preferences.
